work_items.name: 48×48 adult cast, original art and cached layer engine
work_items.description:
Beta.6 candidate rebuilds the custom 48×48 layers around smaller adult faces, longer torsos, tilted shoulders and a hip-set pose. Twelve opaque fantasy/cyborg outfits fit both builds, with independent skin, hair and garment pigments. Bold strappy tops, crop jackets, open coats, bare shoulders and midriffs remain non-explicit; all human characters are 18+, with 28–40 as the workshop default. The authored cast remains independent.
Large custom previews use two cached open/blink frames, scoped to active mounted previews and system motion settings. Small roster portraits stay still. Both native clients render identical pixels with integer physical scaling. Native fixtures hash both frames; structural gates cover 288 hair/headwear/build combinations, all 24 outfit layers and 864 frame combinations. Visual contact sheets and native demo captures are reviewed; structural checks do not measure attractiveness.
Original built-in imagegen reference/prompt, code-native source layers, actual custom gallery, outfit-cut sheet and provenance are versioned under brand/pixel-studio-v3-* and tools/portrait_layers48.py. The website source uses actual custom recipes. Keep in progress for more poses/art variety and broader physical/accessibility/tablet acceptance.
Wireless device acceptance: the paired iPhone 18 Pro Max (iOS 27.0.1) is reachable over the local network without a cable. Production build 10 launches and real Linux/server startup reaches ready in 17.229 seconds, but native provider attachment enters Error and the Scout roster never loads; the smoke test fails. The separate controlled model run was blocked before app launch by the lock screen and cancelled. Physical acceptance has not passed. No production uninstall, provider-key change or model request was performed.
Follow-up source exposes the connection error on Home/Engines, records it in redacted DSH diagnostics, prevents Auto-Lock during full-app acceptance and checks the device lock before building. All 38 client tests pass (34 unit + 4 UI, two opt-in skips), including 19 gateway-state checks; the full diagnostic device app builds. The diagnostic app has not been installed or physically accepted. Existing signed build-10 artifacts predate these source changes.
All three CI jobs passed at ec27e80: https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/actions/runs/39837175768 . Follow-up source needs fresh CI, a replacement iOS build and device verification. Beta.6 remains an unpublished draft (release ID 421093112); beta.5 remains public. Apple accepted build 10 for processing at 2026-10-22T18:55:09Z; tester availability is unverified. Independent art implementation review eaefe46 has no findings, metadata follow-up remains pending and Greptile is blocked by its existing 50-credit quota.
Next: unlock the paired phone, diagnose/fix native attachment, pass physical model/background/cold-history acceptance, replace signed artifacts and remove only temporary QA apps. Continue saved looks/undo, names/voices, real-account generation/delegation, physical Android/16 KB, provider-key storage and Hermes replay. work_items.name: Evaluate Harness2 for evidence-based Pixel improvement
work_items.description: User-linked Harness2 evaluated at google-research/harness2 commit 1cfe254e8d25b15f37048c3730134686abe60335, Apache-2.0, Python 3.12/3.13. Deterministic credential-free demo passed parallel and sequential recursion at k=2: two tasks, zero failures, 28 executions and 32 editor calls. Existing executors are OpenCode/Codex; Hermes/DSH needs a substrate adapter. Proposed next experiment: one bounded probe step per explicitly selected test task on PC/VPS, evidence-based persona/skill/delegation suggestions shown as a reviewed PixelSpec diff, versioned adoption and rollback. Keep secrets, connector authorization and enforced access outside the editable harness. Do not replay side-effecting tasks as probes. Acceptance: real Hermes adapter, independent outcome checks, budget/cancellation/reconnect/partial-failure coverage, evidence redaction and unchanged access. Not integrated or shipped as a mobile runtime. Source and plan: https://github.com/google-research/harness2 and https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/blob/main/PLAN.md.
